title: Sheaf Ext of coherent modules is coherent
statement: Let $X$ be a locally Noetherian scheme [def-pc-scheme], [pqf-def-locnoeth], and let $\mathcal F,\mathcal G$ be coherent $\mathcal O_X$-modules [pqf-def-coherent]. Then for every integer $q$ the sheaf Ext $\mathcal Ext^q_{\mathcal O_X}(\mathcal F,\mathcal G)$ [def-weil-pbc-sheaf-ext] is a coherent $\mathcal O_X$-module [pqf-def-coherent].

source.place: Derived Categories of Schemes, Lemma lemma-coherent-internal-hom (Tag 0D0C), applied to K = F[0] in D^-_Coh and L = G[0] in D^+_Coh: RHom(F,G) lies in D^+_Coh, so its cohomology sheaves Ext^q(F,G) are coherent

proof.text: Coherence, being quasi-coherent of finite type on a locally Noetherian scheme [pqf-lem-coherent-ft-locnoeth], is checked on an affine open cover. Let $x\in X$ and choose, by [pqf-def-locnoeth], an affine open $U=\operatorname{Spec}(A)\ni x$ with $A$ Noetherian. By [pqf-lem-coherent-ft-locnoeth] $\mathcal F$ and $\mathcal G$ are quasi-coherent of finite type, so $M=\mathcal F(U)$ and $N=\mathcal G(U)$ are finite $A$-modules by [lem-weil-pbc-quasi-coherent-finite-type-affine](a), and the counits give isomorphisms $\widetilde M\cong\mathcal F|_U$, $\widetilde N\cong\mathcal G|_U$ by [lem-weil-pbc-affine-tilde-gamma-adjunction](3) (Tag 01XZ).

source.place: Lemma 01XZ, affine characterization of coherent modules on a locally Noetherian scheme

proof.text: By [def-weil-pbc-sheaf-ext], $\mathcal Ext^q_{\mathcal O_X}(\mathcal F,\mathcal G)|_U=\mathcal H^q(R\mathcal Hom_{\mathcal O_X}(\mathcal F[0],\mathcal G[0]))|_U$, and cohomology sheaves commute with restriction to the open $U$ (they are computed termwise). By [lem-sc-derived-internal-hom-restrict-open] (Tag 08DL) this is $\mathcal H^q(R\mathcal Hom_{\mathcal O_U}(\mathcal F|_U[0],\mathcal G|_U[0]))$, which through the isomorphisms of Step 1 and the functoriality of $R\mathcal Hom$ is $\mathcal H^q(R\mathcal Hom_U(\widetilde M[0],\widetilde N[0]))$. By [lem-sc-affine-rhom-qcoherent] this is $0$ for $q<0$ and $\widetilde{\operatorname{Ext}^q_A(M,N)}$ for $q\ge0$.

source.place: Tag 08DL (lemma-restriction-RHom-to-U), with the affine computation of the cited node

proof.text: For $q\ge0$, $\operatorname{Ext}^q_A(M,N)$ is a finite $A$-module by [lem-sc-ext-noetherian-finite], so its associated sheaf $\widetilde{\operatorname{Ext}^q_A(M,N)}$ is quasi-coherent [pqf-def-coherent] and, its global sections being $\operatorname{Ext}^q_A(M,N)$ [lem-weil-pbc-affine-tilde-gamma-adjunction](2), of finite type by [lem-weil-pbc-quasi-coherent-finite-type-affine](a); for $q<0$ it is the zero sheaf. Quasi-coherence and finite type are local, and the $U$ cover $X$, so $\mathcal Ext^q_{\mathcal O_X}(\mathcal F,\mathcal G)$ is quasi-coherent of finite type, hence coherent by [pqf-lem-coherent-ft-locnoeth] (Tag 01XZ).

source.place: lemma-ext-noetherian, with Cohomology of Schemes Lemma 01XZ
